top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a specific invention (Katori's magic-wavelength lattice) and its decisive realisation at the 10^-18 level (Ye), reproduced in Sr and Yb across national laboratories, with measurable uses in geodesy, constants bounds and the redefinition of the second. The two-name allocation is the only one that can be stated without leaving out someone who would have to be defended. The Higgs proposals are scientifically larger but their laureate allocation remains contested (Virdee versus Della Negra), so I rank them next, P002 ahead of P003 because it covers both detectors through detector construction and operation, and P000 last.
